data.description: A vibrant neighborhood with waterfront views, prime connectivity, and a mix of residential and commercial properties.

data.answer: Al Hamriya presents a harmonious blend of residential and commercial spaces, fostering a vibrant community atmosphere. Residents benefit from a plethora of amenities, including shopping centers, supermarkets, and dining establishments, all within easy reach. The neighborhood's strategic location along Dubai Creek not only provides picturesque waterfront views but also ensures a tranquil environment amidst the city's dynamic landscape. The well-planned infrastructure and accessibility to essential services contribute to a high standard of living, making Al Hamriya a sought-after destination for families and professionals alike.

Al Hamriya offers a diverse portfolio of properties, featuring 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, as well as offices and shops. This variety caters to a wide spectrum of residents and businesses, ensuring that individual preferences and requirements are met with quality options.

Popular Buildings in Al Hamriya

Abdul Razak Building 44 is a five-story residential building that offers residential units with modern amenities, providing comfortable living spaces for its residents.

Al Ansari Building 11 is a four-story residential building, featuring well-designed apartments, ensuring a convenient lifestyle with its strategic location and facilities.

Ahmad Falakanz Building provides a range of residential units, catering to diverse family sizes and offering essential amenities.

Abdul Rahman Building 93 offers spacious apartments, designed to meet the needs of modern families seeking comfort and convenience.

Abdul Khader Building Hamriya features residential units with contemporary designs, ensuring a pleasant living experience for its occupants.

Renting a Property in Al Hamriya

Al Hamriya presents a variety of properties for rent, including 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, as well as offices and shops. This selection caters to individuals and businesses seeking properties for rent in Dubai, offering diverse options to suit various needs.

Buying a Property in Al Hamriya

For those interested in investing, Al Hamriya provides properties for sale, encompassing 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and commercial spaces such as offices and shops. This variety makes it an attractive option for investors looking for properties for sale in Dubai.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Hamriya?

data.answer:
Living in Al Hamriya offers residents a strategic location along Dubai Creek, providing picturesque waterfront views and a tranquil environment. The area boasts a variety of amenities, including shopping centers, supermarkets, and dining establishments, ensuring convenience for daily needs. Its proximity to major roads facilitates easy connectivity to other parts of Dubai, making it an ideal choice for both families and professionals seeking a balanced urban lifestyle.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Al Hamriya

Al Hamriya's strategic location offers excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai via Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), approximately a 12-minute drive away. Residents benefit from private parking facilities, ensuring convenient vehicle storage within the community.

Supermarkets in Al Hamriya

Residents have access to several supermarkets, including Al Maya Supermarket, Safa Al Madina Supermarket, and Al Hidaya Supermarket, providing a wide range of grocery options within the community.

Shopping Malls in Al Hamriya

Central Mall in Al Hamriya offers a variety of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities, providing a comprehensive shopping experience for residents and visitors alike.

Schools and Nurseries near Al Hamriya

Little Diamond Nursery in Al Mankhool offers early childhood education, providing foundational learning experiences for young children. It is about a 10-minute drive from Al Hamriya.

About a 15-minute drive away, Hemaya Kindergarten in Al Karama provides kindergarten education, focusing on early childhood development and learning.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Al Hamriya Location

Al Hamriya is home to several mosques, including the Grand Mosque and Iranian Mosque, both within a short distance, providing convenient places of worship for Muslim residents.

Nearby, the Hindu Temple in Bur Dubai and the Shiva Temple are approximately a 10-minute drive away, serving the spiritual needs of the Hindu community.

For Christian residents, St. Mary's Catholic Church and Holy Trinity Church are accessible within a 15-minute drive, offering regular services and community activities.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Al Hamriya

Residents have access to healthcare facilities such as Aster Clinic and Mediclinic Al Noor, both within a 10-minute drive, providing a range of medical services to meet the community's needs.

Al Hamriya Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Al Hamriya is strategically situated near prominent areas including Al Fahidi, Al Karama, Umm Hurair 1, and Al Rigga, offering residents easy access to a variety of cultural, commercial, and recreational destinations.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Hamriya

data.answer:
Al Hamriya offers a range of amenities, including shopping centers, dining establishments, and recreational facilities, providing residents with various options for leisure and entertainment.

Al Hamriya Restaurants

Al Hamriya boasts a diverse culinary scene with restaurants such as Al Fanar Restaurant, offering traditional Emirati cuisine in a setting that reflects Dubai's rich heritage. For those craving Indian flavors, Maharaja Bhog serves an extensive vegetarian thali, providing an authentic taste of India. Additionally, Yoko Sizzlers specializes in sizzling platters, combining various meats and vegetables to cater to diverse palates.

Beaches near Al Hamriya

La Mer Beach, around 18 minutes away, combines beachfront leisure with a lively atmosphere, featuring trendy retail outlets, dining spots, and water activities. Its vibrant design and family-friendly facilities make it an excellent getaway for residents of Al Hamriya.

Jumeirah Beach, located approximately 20 minutes from Al Hamriya, is a popular destination offering pristine sands, jogging tracks, and a variety of water sports. The beach is lined with cafes and restaurants, making it a perfect spot for a relaxing day by the sea.

Hotels in Al Hamriya

Al Hamriya offers excellent accommodation options, including Al Khoory Inn, which features modern rooms, complimentary Wi-Fi, a fitness center, and an on-site restaurant. Al Seef Heritage Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton provides a unique stay with traditional Arabian architecture, waterfront views, and authentic dining experiences. 
Majestic Premier Hotel offers elegantly furnished rooms, an outdoor swimming pool, and multiple dining options, making it a great choice for both business and leisure travelers.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

The community provides various outdoor activities, including parks and recreational areas. Fitness enthusiasts have access to gyms, while beauty salons cater to personal care needs, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle for residents.

Al Hamriya Attractions and Landmarks

Located along Dubai Creek, Al Seef Street offers a blend of traditional and modern experiences, featuring retail outlets, dining options, and cultural attractions, approximately a 5-minute drive from Al Hamriya.

Situated in the Al Seef area, the Museum of Illusions provides interactive exhibits and mind-bending displays, offering a unique experience just a short drive from Al Hamriya.

Located in the Al Fahidi area, the Dubai Museum showcases the city's rich history and heritage, featuring exhibits that depict traditional life in Dubai, approximately a 10-minute drive from Al Hamriya.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms and Salons

Al Hamriya offers various outdoor activities for residents, including parks and recreational areas. Fitness options are available with several gyms in the vicinity, and both fitness centers and beauty salons are conveniently located within the community, providing ample options for health, wellness, and grooming needs.

Al Hamriya offers a well-balanced lifestyle with its strategic location, excellent connectivity, and an array of amenities. The community is ideal for both families and professionals, thanks to its residential and commercial offerings. While the area is vibrant and bustling, those seeking a quieter atmosphere might find peak-hour traffic a challenge. However, the well-planned infrastructure and accessibility to major roads like Sheikh Zayed Road ensure smooth commutes and connectivity across Dubai.

What types of properties are available in Al Hamriya?

Al Hamriya offers 1 to 4-bedroom apartments for rent and sale, along with commercial properties such as offices and shops.

How well-connected is Al Hamriya to the rest of Dubai?

The community enjoys excellent connectivity through Khalid Bin Al Waleed Road (D79) and Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), which is approximately a 12-minute drive away.

Are there any supermarkets in Al Hamriya?

Yes, residents have access to supermarkets such as Al Maya Supermarket, Safa Al Madina Supermarket, and Al Hidaya Supermarket.

What are the main attractions near Al Hamriya?

Nearby attractions include Al Seef Street, the Museum of Illusions, and Dubai Museum, all offering cultural and leisure experiences within a short drive.

What are the healthcare facilities available near Al Hamriya?

Medical facilities such as Aster Clinic and Mediclinic Al Noor are located within a 10-minute drive, providing comprehensive healthcare services.

data.content:
Nestled in Bur Dubai, Al Hamriya is a well-established community along the scenic Dubai Creek. Its prime location along Khalid Bin Al Waleed Road (D79) and proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) ensures convenient access to the rest of the city. The area is a blend of residential and commercial spaces, making it an attractive choice for families, professionals, and business owners.

The neighborhood features a diverse range of apartments for rent and sale, catering to different lifestyle needs. From compact 1-bedroom units to spacious 4-bedroom residences, the residential options ensure a comfortable living experience. Commercial properties, including offices and retail shops, contribute to the dynamic business environment.

Al Hamriya is enriched with essential amenities that enhance the quality of life for residents. Supermarkets, shopping centers, restaurants, and healthcare facilities are all within easy reach, ensuring convenience for daily needs. Its waterfront setting offers a serene atmosphere, complementing the area's vibrant urban character while providing a balanced lifestyle.
